title: Fast and accurate AI-based pre-decoders for color codes
summary: Color codes are promising alternatives to surface codes for universal fault-tolerant quantum computing due to their simpler lattice-surgery protocols and the transversal implementation of logical Clifford gates. However, their practical deployment has been limited by slower decoding algorithms and worse logical failure rates and thresholds compared to surface codes.
